title: Signal engine: daily walk-forward refit: every active model x target refitted on the rolling window (14 days direction, 28 days resolution, <= 400k rows per target, float32) using only labels available before the fit time; write-once artifacts + fit.json; exit 75 when the last fit is < 20 h old
expected_value: fresh champion / challenger fits every day (prediction always uses a fit made at or before the capture start)
next_action: daily; due-check every 30 min (<= 41 consecutive tempfails between productive runs, under the 48 cap)
notes: Promoted 2026-10-21 by the signal-engine autopilot (signal engine v1, docs/research_lab/signal_engine/DESIGN_V1.md section 9). Measured on the host 2026-10-20 23:26-23:45Z in a read-only dry run (/tmp/sigeng, engine root outside ~/arepo, deleted afterwards). 27 captures (2.3 days), 385,190-row frame: 6.7-7.5 min, peak RSS 1.04-1.07 GB under a 3.0 GB address-space cap. The frame is capped by max_rows, so a full 14-day window keeps the same frame size (more captures read: ~+30 s) plus the 24 h LightGBM fits that need > 1 day of history (+~4 min): expect 10-15 min, ~1.1 GB. Not exclusive (< 1.5 GB). Never the MC1 failure mode: no full panel is materialised (one capture at a time, seeded per-capture subsample, float32). depends_on is empty on purpose: the other engine jobs are repeat jobs that never reach 'done'; missing inputs make this job exit 75 or report 'insufficient'/'no_fit' instead.
